description: This file contains database migration scripts for the Superset project, specifically for inverting the horizontal bar chart order. It defines a database schema class 'Slice' and two functions 'upgrade' and 'downgrade' to modify chart parameters related to x-axis sorting and orientation.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: Declarative class to do query in upgrade

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Function to invert the x-axis sort order for horizontal bar charts in the database.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Function to revert the x-axis sort order inversion for horizontal bar charts in the database.
